## What's Changed
* Update dependency eslint to v10.11.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/114
* Update dependency typescript-eslint to v8.70.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/138
* Update jackson monorepo to v2.22.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/153
* C1: Preserve parked siblings during recovery by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/139
* C2: Reject unsupported parallel join topology by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/140
* C5: Validate nested workflow JSON boundaries by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/143
* C7: Enforce immutable JSON snapshot ownership by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/145
* C9: Centralize editor document and history transactions by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/147
* C11: Make workflow diffs semantic and layout-tolerant by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/149
* C3: Bound iterative error recovery by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/141
* C4: Enforce async completion and active-node contracts by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/142
* C12: Preserve structured errors and harden host SPI by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/150
* Update dependency typescript-eslint to v8.71.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/158
* Update dependency vite to v8.3.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/155
* Update slf4j monorepo to v2.0.20 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/154
* Update dependency @xyflow/react to v12.12.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/156
* Filter Action Type options once the list exceeds 8 entries by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/157
* Integrate remaining code-quality review branches into main by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/159


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/compare/v2.0.3...v2.5.0
